name: Hip Flexion with Band
instructions: Secure one end of the band to the lower portion of a post and attach the other to one ankle.
Face away from the attachment point of the band.
Keeping your head and your chest up, raise your knee up to 90 degrees and pause.
Return the leg to the starting position.
prompt: This is a Hip Flexion with Band for strength that uses pull force to primarily train the quadriceps. These are the instructions that a person would receive: "Secure one end of the band to the lower portion of a post and attach the other to one ankle. Face away from the attachment point of the band. Keeping your head and your chest up, raise your knee up to 90 degrees and pause. Return the leg to the starting position."
